speaker: Arne Slot
quote_text:
What was your take on the game? Nothing could  come from losing a game of football. But if I  
have to take the positives, there were definitely  a few positives. So dominating ball possession in  
Stamford Bridge is not what many teams do over  here, because Chelsea is so comfortable with  
the ball as well. Being 2-0 down, don't give  up. Try to fight yourself back into the game,  
that's what we did. We got already two big  chances, which we didn't score then. Chelsea was  
on a counter-attack a few times, very threatening.  And then when we scored a 2-1, you were like,  
let's see if there's something in it. But I don't  think there was a moment where we were close to  
scoring a goal and in the end, the correct penalty  being given and Chelsea won 3-1. So maybe the  
opposite from the home game where they dominated  possession and we won. Now it was the opposite.  
I mean, the difference Dominik made when he came  on, I mean, sometimes it feels like your pressing  
relies on him. Do you think in hindsight that  perhaps it was the midfield that you lost the game  
in the end? Because I feel like Harvey struggled  a little bit. Nah, it's never about one player,  
but one of the main, one of the qualities Dom  definitely has is the intensity he presses  
with. So you can come up with all the tactics  in the world, but it's always the intensity of  
the press that makes the difference. It doesn't  matter what I come up with, but if we are intense,  
it's so difficult to play through us. And one  of the qualities Dominik has is definitely  
the pressing part, and that's why he played so  much this season as well. And I want to know,  
why did Federico Chiesa not get more minutes,  and is he in your plans going forward? Because  
I decided to bring other players in first, because  I already brought Darwin in. So that wasn't the  
position I could bring him in. Then Cody Gakpo, I  liked him a lot today, played a really good game  
and I've changed him, took him out in the last  few weeks many times already. And Mo is always  
a player that can score a goal, so that's why I  first made different substitutions and in the end,  
I would almost say like people expect from me  over here is that we take an extra risk, so get  
a defender out, bring Federico in. That also led  to us scoring a goal, but not enough time left  
for him to make the difference, unfortunately.  Arne, did any impact on already being champions  
or rotating your team affect you from today  if you think that had an impact? That we will  
never know. But I think what we also saw today,  a lot of things, what we've seen throughout the  
whole season, us playing through the high press of  the opponent so many times, so many moments that  
we arrived in the final third. But I also saw  us defending today, not that I'm used to that  
always. So the last percentages over there were  not over normal standards. And in the final third,  
we are, if we go, if we come there so many times,  normally we are able to create more chances. So  
that would mean two things. Chelsea did well in  both boxes, which they did. But I think it tells  
us also a little bit about us. So in general, good  performance, but the final percentages weren't  
there to win this game of football. The lead up  to both goals, a player of us slipped. So yeah,  
would that have happened as well if the game  was on the line? Yes or no, we will never know,  
but the margins are small in the Premier League,  especially if you play a team like Chelsea with  
so many quality players, then you cannot afford  these kind of moments. I know you got the guard  
of honour from Chelsea, but their fans did  seem so impressed. There was a bit of booing,  
wasn't it? Was that disappointing from your  point of view? They didn't like the team then,  
or what? They didn't like their team? They booed  for their team? No, I think they were booing for  
us. I didn't hear it, to be honest. So I only  heard our fans during almost the whole game.  
And I just heard that they couldn't come here  with trains, so they had to go by car. But they  
were in time, and they were loud throughout the  whole game. So I haven't heard anyone booing,  
I've only heard our fans singing. Congratulations,  Yvonne Lee. What have you and your players learnt  
over the season that you can take forward to next  year and possibly into Europe and win something  
there? That the margins are small and that's been  throughout the whole season in the games we've won  
and today again as well. So you slipped twice, you  concede two goals. Paris Saint-Germain, incredible  
game, maybe the best game of our season at  home, where we dominated the second half,  
we were just waiting for us to score a goal, which  we didn't. Then, because players got tired, I had  
to make quite a lot of substitutions. We were  lucky to end up taking the penalties. And yeah,  
talking about small margins, losing the penalty  shootout, and they are now in the semi-final,  
we are out. So yes, we all have quality players.  Chelsea has them, City has them, Arsenal has them,  
Villa has them. City, do I get a few up there?  We have so many in this league. And we have them  
as well. But the margins are small, and that's  why you have to work so hard every three days  
to get so many points on board. And that's what  we did this season, and everyone have any chance  
of competing next season. That is the minimum  we need again. Thank you. Just asking Chelsea  
a threat for next season, you think? I expected  them to be a threat this season because they were  
at Anfield. They were better than us. They were  so close to us. So it was a complete surprise  
to me that we are now 18 points clear of them,  something like that. I didn't feel that at all  
coming when we played them. So that tells you  how well we did probably if a team like this  
with so much quality and also not only in  the first eleven but in the complete squad  
we are able to be 18 points ahead of them is a big  compliment for our players. Thank you. Thank you.
title: Arne Slot post-match press conference | Chelsea 3-1 Liverpool
